chunk_findings.detail: The change claims to salvage every probe scenario, and the intent states the probes "exist nowhere else" (they are uncommitted files in `/tmp` worktrees). The diff delivers tests for scenarios (2), (3) and (4) only: the new block appended to `tests/test_stale_after_merge.py` asserts the *kept-worktree + untracked scratch file* case (`run_cli(repo, "config", "worktree.remove_on_merge", "false")`, `(tree / "scratch.txt").write_text(...)`), and the two new tests in `tests/test_asagent_tree.py` exercise the `--no-worktree` gate and merge cases via `_cli_no_worktree`. Nothing added (or present in the shown file tail, which ends at `_commit_all_matches(repo)` before the appended test) drives an ff-only merge whose branch head is itself a merge commit and then asserts `NOTE not in out + err` on `complete`. Concrete consequence: given a T1 branch whose tip is a merge commit, an ff-only merge followed by `complete T1 --model claude-opus-5`, the "gates flagged stale" false positive that probe (1) reproduced has no regression coverage, and because the only copy lives in the stray `/tmp` worktree, that scenario is lost for good once those directories are cleaned up. Either the probe must be salvaged as an asserting test (or `xfail(strict=True)` with a filed bug id, as was done for scenario (2)), or the omission has to be explicitly accounted for.

The diff is declared "part 1 of 1" (complete), so no other hunk can carry it; `test_stale_after_merge.py` receives exactly one appended function, which is the kept-worktree/untracked-scratch test for scenario (2) (docstring: "Salvaged probe (/tmp/rev74e)"), and `test_asagent_tree.py` receives only the two `--no-worktree` tests for scenarios (3) and (4). Given the intent states these probe scenarios "exist nowhere else" (uncommitted in /tmp/rev74e and /tmp/review-parent), the merge-commit-head staleness case loses its only regression test; a future change that makes `complete` flag gates stale after an ff-only merge whose branch head is a merge commit will not be caught by this suite.
